messages.subject: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Hallo,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

It is good to hear from Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH. We have looked at your request carefully for our shop. We can offer you a price of €36.00 per unit. 

We always aim to deliver top quality from our machines for your orders, and we look forward to working together on this project. Let us know if this works for you.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH

messages.subject: Re: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series (1)
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

thank you for your offer regarding rfq: pump shaft for the new hx series.
We hold a competing offer at 31.50 EUR per unit (offer:70240-0).
PPI-D351 changed by -3.7226% over the referenced annual window (idx:PPI-D351@2025-08, idx:PPI-D351@2026-08).
Your recorded on-time delivery rate is 80.8 % (sc:70210@2026Q3).
Each of the attached packages works for us; please choose the one that suits you best.
We commit to a binding volume of 4,200 pcs per year over 24 months.
Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?
We value our cooperation.

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series (1)
messages.body:
Hallo,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We did not know that - a fair point. 

Material accounts for about 34 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. We need to clarify this internally - we will come back to you on price. 

Because cash is important for our shop, I am choosing your package with 14 days payment and dropping the price to 30.50 EUR for the 4,200 pieces. Our current Angebot is a price of €30.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 28 days. Let's agree on this and get the machines running.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH

Each of the attached packages works for us; please choose the one that suits you best.

Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series (2)
messages.body:
Hallo,

We have clarified this internally and can move further on the price. I make the decisions here, so I have reviewed your volume commitment. We can accept your terms and await your order. 

Our currentangebot is a price of €28.79 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 28 days. With the binding volume of 4,200 pieces and 14 days payment, I can offer you 28.00 EUR. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? Let's agree on this so we can get the machines running.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH
